01 / What I can help you solve

Business problems
I tackle

I'm a growth operator who diagnoses pipeline issues, improves workflows, and helps teams close more deals.

Sales pipeline stalls and nobody knows why

My approach: I map every step from first contact to close, talk to customers who dropped off, and find where the friction actually is—not where we assume it is.

Evidence: Jumbo Homes: Currently managing property sales end-to-end across multiple zones.

Outreach takes too long and follow-ups get missed

My approach: I automate the prep work so your team spends time on conversations, not admin. Built a Gmail draft generator from lead data using Google Sheets.

Evidence: Seller outreach agent (see Work section)

Customer needs aren't clear from the data

My approach: I use Jobs to Be Done and direct customer conversations to understand what progress they're trying to make, then prioritize what matters.

Evidence: Applied JTBD framework to property buyer qualification

Projects involve too many teams and unclear ownership

My approach: I coordinate across supply, marketing, legal, and ops teams. I keep the next action clear and follow up until it's done.

Evidence: Jumbo Homes: Coordinating supply onboarding, buyer visits, negotiation, legal coordination

Agent workflows fail because they skip human judgment

My approach: I design AI-assisted workflows with approval gates at decision points. Automation handles prep; humans handle judgment.

Evidence: Listing image workflow design with 3 approval gates (design phase)
